selection: native when the optional extension can be imported; Python otherwise; JIT explicit
scope: Malbolge20 batch CLI, including redirected stdin

compatibility.runtime_errors: propagate without replay on another engine
compatibility.terminal_streaming: Python when no batch options are selected
compatibility.benchmark_pipeline: unchanged; runtime uses core.run_memory and traces use diagnostic loop
compatibility.plain_cli_source: legacy UTF-8 text loader preserved; automatic batch reports invalid instructions with exit 2

validation.command: uv run --offline --no-sync pytest test/test_engine_selection.py test/test_native_vm.py test/test_native_jit.py test/test_runtime_qos.py test/test_cli_qos.py -q
validation.skip_reason: unsupported-JIT-host branch skipped on a supported ARM64 JIT host
validation.independent_review: No actionable findings; native/default/CLI/TTY/input/budget/error boundaries reviewed. Reviewer checks are subsets of the central focused run and are not added to its total.
